description: PS5 store and download manager with a browser UI on port 34177. Library integration requires ShadowMountPlus.

changelog: **LZ4 🦎 comes to Orbit**, alongside more games and improvements to downloads, TorBox and Library moves.

**Find LZ4 games.** Select **LZ4** in the Format filter in Orbit Store’s browser, native PS5 app or Orbit Zero, in all four interfaces. The catalogue includes **49 LZ4 download options across 48 PS5 games**.

**More games and download choices.** Orbit’s catalogue now contains **2,103 games: 1,132 PS5 and 971 PS4**, with **4,940 game download options**, plus **626 DLCs and add-ons with 628 options across 192 base games**.
> **Orbit stays free.** Orbit Store, Orbit Zero, [Orbit Play](https://github.com/saawant12/orbit-play-ps5) and the Orbit apps still to come are free, and they’ll stay that way.

> Until now, development time, AI tools, test consoles, hardware and the servers behind Orbit have all been paid out of pocket. The bigger Orbit gets, the more it costs, so we’ve opened an optional [Buy Me a Coffee page](https://buymeacoffee.com/saawant12) to help.
> We used to say Orbit didn’t accept donations. That has changed, and buymeacoffee.com/saawant12 is the only place Orbit accepts money.
We’re also shipping improvements and bug fixes across our apps:

**Better download recovery.** Interrupted connections retry from their saved position while other parts of the download continue. Resume checks the saved provider link and tells you when it needs refreshing. Brief service timeouts no longer immediately show Orbit as unavailable in the TV app.
**A major update:** Orbit gets a file manager, saved filters, and streaming game installs straight from your computer with Orbit Zero, saving space on your PS5. Vikingfile accounts now work too.
**File manager comes to Orbit.** Open **Library → Files** to browse your PS5’s drives, copy or move files, rename, delete, unpack archives and install games.
**Save your filters.** Name the filters you use most in Browse or Add-ons and apply them again in one go. They work in the browser, TV app and Orbit Zero.

**Stream installs from your computer.** In Orbit Zero, download a PKG or FPKG to your computer and send it to the PS5 installer over your home network. No second copy goes into the PS5’s download folder, but the PS5 still needs space for the installed game.

**Vikingfile accounts.** Sign in through the official provider page. Orbit checks the session and tries to obtain a download link without opening another window. If Vikingfile asks for verification, complete it and wait for Orbit to pick up the ready link.
This update also brings the catalogue to **2,090 games with 4,895 download options**, plus **626 add-ons with 628 download options across 192 base games**.

**A file manager on your PS5.** Library → Files shows internal, USB and available extended drives. Copy and move run in the background with progress, pause and resume. Orbit protects files in use and asks before deletion. Save a file to your paired phone or computer, or unpack ZIP, RAR and 7z archives on the console.

**Library keeps up.** Game sizes are measured automatically. Adding a game through Files or connecting a drive triggers a scan when a compatible ShadowMount is available. Scan for games remains available as a fallback. Installed packages also appear when ShadowMount does not list them.

**Sign in to Vikingfile on PS5.** Open Vikingfile account from settings, enter your account code on the provider’s page and complete any verification. Back in Orbit, choose Check sign-in to see whether the session is confirmed. The native app and PS5 browser have separate sign-ins.
**Cinema improvements.** Library and Downloads use the Store layout with Cinema’s colours.
**New in Orbit 1.6.0:** notifications on your phone, up to 64 connections per download and other improvements.
**Notifications on your phone.** Orbit can now notify you through [ntfy](https://ntfy.sh), on your phone or computer, as well as on your PS5. Use ntfy.sh or your own server.

**Up to 64 connections per download.** Choose from 1 to 64 in **App settings → Storage**. Eight stays the default. More connections only help when the source allows them; if a host refuses, Orbit retries with fewer.
**More control over Browse.** Select multiple formats or sources at once, use **PlayStation exclusive** and other game tags, and hide games already installed or saved on a drive.
**Free up space after installing.** Orbit can delete a PKG or FPKG once it has installed on your PS5. It's off by default.
This update also pushes Orbit’s catalogue to **2,045 games with 4,834 download options**, plus **542 add-ons with 544 download options across 138 base games**.

**Notifications have their own settings.** In **App settings → Notifications**, choose where to notify (on this PS5, through ntfy, or both) and what about: downloads that finish or fail, packages that install or fail to install, and new Orbit releases. When a package installs, the notification also says whether the downloaded file was deleted. Orbit checks for a new release ten minutes after it starts and then every six hours, and tells you about each release once.

**Set up ntfy.** Open **Change ntfy settings** and enter a server address, a topic and, if your server needs one, a username and password, then choose **Send test notification**. For an access token, leave the username empty and enter the token as the password. The password is never shown again after saving.
**Delete packages after installing.** Turn it on in **App settings → Storage → Installed packages**. If installation fails, or the file changed after Orbit checked it, the file is kept.
**Connections are shared.** Downloads running at the same time share up to 64 connections, and a download that has already started keeps its split.
**A major update:** DLCs, game installation support and over 2,000 games now in Orbit.

**Install without leaving Orbit.** After a PKG or FPKG downloads or transfers, choose **Install on PS5**. If a download has several packages, pick the ones you want. For exFAT, FFPFSC and extracted game folders, Orbit asks ShadowMount to scan for them, if a supported version is running.
**We’re starting with 408 add-ons for 43 games.** Browse and download expansions, content packs, activation packages and bundles on the new **Add-ons** page, or from a game’s details.
**Over 2,000 games.** This update adds 195 games (188 PS4 and 7 PS5) and 71 more download choices for games already in Orbit. The catalogue now has 2,026 games.
**Know what your firmware can run.** Download options show the firmware they need, when it’s known. Options that won’t run on your PS5 are listed last with a warning, and you can still download them.

**Update Orbit in one step.** **Update Orbit** updates the TV app and the download service together. If your ELF loader is running, Orbit restarts itself and picks up your downloads where they left off. You can also restart Orbit on its own from Updates.
**Download notifications.** Your PS5 tells you when a download finishes or fails, in your console’s language. You can turn this off in settings.

**Save a diagnostic report.** In the TV app, **More settings → Save diagnostic report** saves a report you can attach to a bug report, on a USB drive or the PS5’s own storage. It has no game titles, download links, passwords or tokens.
**Better download retries.** Downloads resume from the progress saved on your drive, and Retry still works if the partial file was deleted or is empty.

**Find the right add-on.** Search by add-on or game name, and filter by platform, type, source and region, in every interface. An add-on’s details show which game it needs, and any version it requires, before you download.
**More games, better download recovery, and the freedom to download to your computer now and transfer to your PS5 later.**

**104 games added in recent catalogue updates: 86 PS5 and 18 PS4.** Orbit now includes **1,702 games and 3,991 download options**, with 166 more options since 1.3.5. These catalogue updates are already available to existing users.

**More control over download recovery.** Choose how many times Orbit retries, the delay between attempts, and when a slow download should reconnect. Repeated failures use fewer connections while keeping saved progress.

**Larger files through TorBox.** Orbit now sends the request to TorBox instead of blocking it based on its advertised file-size limit. Your account and the source still determine availability; any rejection appears in Downloads.
**More in New on Orbit.** Discover now shows up to 40 games in the collection.
**Download without a PS5.** Choose **Save to → This computer** to download and keep a game locally. Send it to your PS5 later when you’re ready.

**Smoother Vikingfile and AkiraBox downloads.** Complete the provider’s verification, then wait. Orbit Zero captures the ready download link and returns automatically, without manually pressing Download.

**Refresh expired links with your PS5 offline.** Refresh an interrupted computer download’s link without reconnecting the console or its drive. Orbit checks that it is the same file before continuing from saved progress.

**Better transfer recovery.** Resume the PS5 transfer while the computer download continues, or restart a transfer from a retained computer copy. Clearer errors explain when a destination file already exists or a saved PS5 file has changed.
**Cleaner extracted game folders.** Redundant wrapper folders are removed when an archive contains a recognised game directory. Other files and folders are preserved.
Archive.org sign-in comes to Orbit.
Archive.org sign-in. Connect your account in the native PS5 app, browser or Orbit Zero to access downloads that require signing in.
225 unavailable Archive.org links removed, and 3 games also had to go. Links that require an Archive.org account are still included.

TorBox downloads on your computer. Connect TorBox in Download settings, download through supported sources and transfer to your PS5.
Recover completed downloads from your computer cache. Restore a removed download entry and transfer the saved file without downloading it again.
Reconnect after your PS5's address changes. Update its address and verify the connection. Recovery is also available after pairing has been reset.
Better download and transfer recovery. Interrupted computer downloads retry automatically. Resume stalled PS5 transfers or remove stuck entries from Downloads while keeping their files.
**A new look for Orbit, with 400 more games to explore.**
**400 new games:** 200 PS5 and 200 PS4, bringing Orbit’s catalogue to **1,601 games**: 1,001 PS5 and 600 PS4.

**2,085 more download options.** There are 532 links for the new games and **1,553 additional source or format choices for 700 existing games**. The catalogue now offers **4,050 download options** across Archive.org, Vikingfile and AkiraBox. **Our promise remains the same: single-link downloads.**

**Three new interfaces across all apps.** Choose **Crossbar**, **Cinema** or **Panorama** in the native PS5 app, browser and Orbit Zero. Store remains the default, and your queue, favourites and settings stay with you when you switch.
**Browse without page breaks.** Keep scrolling through Discover’s All games, Browse and Library. More items appear as you move through the list.
**Controller navigation throughout.** Move between sections, games and their actions, with menus and confirmation panels keeping the selection while they’re open.
**A refreshed desktop experience.** The new interfaces also cover Console, Downloads, Library and Settings.
**More Browse controls.** Show favourites, filter by download size, change the sort order and reset your filters across every interface.
**Find your downloaded files.** Download details show the full PS5 destination and the computer location while a cached copy remains.

**More games, more sources and built-in ZIP, RAR and 7z archive extraction.**
**271 new games:** 200 PS4 and 71 PS5, bringing Orbit’s catalogue to **1,201 games** across all three apps.

**AkiraBox joins Orbit.** Choose from **272 AkiraBox download links** across the catalogue. First, open your **Sources** settings, enable **AkiraBox** and save your selection. Then open AkiraBox, complete verification and wait. Orbit automatically picks up the download link, so there’s no need to press Download manually.

**More download choices.** We’ve added **578 download links**: 272 for the new games and **306 additional source or format options for 264 existing games**. These additions include **41 compressed downloads** across the supported sources.
We’re constantly adding more games and download sources.
**Archive extraction on PS5.** Download and extract supported ZIP, RAR and 7z files directly to your selected drive, with password entry when needed.
**Improved external USB drive downloads.** Addresses stalls when downloading large files to USB drives and prevents a busy USB drive from blocking checks on other drives.
**Download controls across the apps.** Choose 1–8 simultaneous games in the browser and native app.
**Browser and controller improvements**, clearer storage information and release years on game details.
**More reliable catalogue updates.** New catalogue versions load correctly after updating the app.
**A big update: PS4 games join Orbit, now with 200 PS4 games and 930 games across PS4 and PS5 editions, with more coming soon.**
**Orbit Zero in your language.** Choose English, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian or Turkish from the Language menu.
**Download more at once.** Download two games to your computer at a time, or choose a different limit in Download settings.

**Recover interrupted transfers.** Resume after reconnecting to your PS5, clear a partial transfer, or stop a stuck job while keeping its remaining files. A stopped job no longer blocks the next transfer.
**PS4 browsing on desktop.** Find PS4 editions using the Platform filter, with game descriptions, release dates, covers and backgrounds.
**Square to favourite.** Press Square on a selected game in native Browse or Discover to add or remove it from Favourites.
**More reliable service restarts.** Orbit checks that the installed service has actually replaced the previous session and tells you when the wrong version is still running.
**Local hostnames.** Open Orbit’s browser interface using local names ending in `.home.arpa`, `.local` or `.localhost`, as well as the PS5’s IP address.
**TorBox limit messages.** Download options shows the limit reported by TorBox when a file is too large for that source.
**Browse by platform.** Find PS4 and PS5 editions using the Platform filter, with clear PS4 labels and complete game details for the new additions. The app continues to run on PS5.
**More games, faster transfers, and more control over your downloads.**

**Download and transfer improvements.** The speed-optimized improvements are now included in the standard Orbit Zero builds and the matching PS5 service. Orbit Zero also reconnects to your saved PS5 when you reopen it.
**A better Vikingfile window.** Orbit Zero blocks unwanted popups and adds Back, Reload and Return to download page controls. Complete any verification, then select Download on the provider page.
**Choose your computer download folder.** Change it from Console or the new Download settings menu. Existing partial downloads stay in their original folder.

**Keep computer storage clear.** Optionally remove computer copies after the PS5 confirms a successful transfer, or use Clear completed cache. Your PS5 files and download history stay in place. Automatic cleanup is off by default.
**Desktop update checks.** Orbit Zero checks for new versions automatically. Download the verified package for your computer and open it when you are ready to install.

**More games and download choices.** 15 new games and more options for 122 existing games bring Orbit to **720 games and 1,174 download options**. This update adds **151 single-file Vikingfile options: 102 exFAT, 46 FPKG and 3 FFPFSC**.
**Orbit Store in Hungarian.** Magyar joins the browser and native PS5 apps, bringing Orbit Store to 11 interface languages. Thanks to [isty1974](https://github.com/isty1974) for the translation.

**Introducing Orbit Zero, our desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux.**
**Download on your computer, transfer to your PS5.** Orbit Zero downloads files and transfers them to your console at the same time. Works over your local network: Wi-Fi or Ethernet.

**Use Orbit without internet on your PS5.** Your computer handles online downloads while your PS5 stays connected to your home network. Browse and receive files on the console without giving it internet access.
**Control downloads from either device.** Browse and manage your computer's queue from Orbit Zero or the matching Orbit Store app on your PS5.
**Choose where downloads run.** Use your computer, or prefer direct PS5 downloads when the console can reach the source. Save your preference once.
**See both stages clearly.** Track download and PS5 transfer speeds separately, with pause, resume and reconnect controls.

**Start Orbit on your PS5 without internet.** Install and open Orbit Zero, go to **Console**, enter your PS5’s local IP address, then use **Start Orbit on PS5** to upload and launch Orbit. Pair with the code shown on your PS5. No separate ELF download is needed. Keep both devices on the same local network, with your PS5’s jailbreak and Payload Manager or ELF loader already running.

**Already using Orbit Store 0.9.x?** Stop the old service in Orbit Store’s browser app under **App settings → Update / reinstall → Stop Orbit to restart**. Then upload and start the new ELF through Orbit Zero. Your settings, pairing and queue stay saved. If you use the native TV app, install this release’s **PPSA99177.ffpkg** too.
We’re continually improving download and transfer speeds across Orbit. Thank you for your patience.
Check your connection, available storage, download preference and active transfers from the Console page.
**Storage detection fixed.** Restores internal storage and M.2 SSDs that were missing after updating to 0.9.0.

Download `PPSA99177.ffpkg` and its `.sha256` file, verify the checksum, then copy the FFPKG to `/data/homebrew/` on your PS5. Let ShadowMountPlus register it and open **Orbit Store** from the **Games row**. Discover opens first. Choose your sources in the native app's setup screen or **App settings → Download sources**.

If an older Orbit service is already running, stop it deliberately before opening the app so its new bundled service can start. The app preserves a newer saved service. The native app version is **1.2.2**, bundled with Orbit service **0.9.1**.

Download `orbit_store.elf` and its checksum, then run it through your payload manager or ELF loader. Open the Orbit shortcut in the **Media tab**, or pair a phone at `http://<ps5-ip>:34177/` on the same network.

Existing users can update the service through **App settings → Update / reinstall**, choose **Stop Orbit to restart**, then run the saved `/data/orbit-store/orbit_store.elf` or a synced manager copy. Loading a replacement while Orbit is running saves it for the next start. Pairing, source choices and the queue remain saved.

In the browser, **App settings → TV app** installs the native app from the official feed. The native app has separate TV app and download service controls under **App settings → Updates**. Installation and service restart require your choice. After updating the TV app, close and reopen it. If ShadowMountPlus still opens an older app, restart the console when convenient and run your jailbreak again.
`orbit_store.elf` and `orbit_store.elf.sha256`: download service and browser interface.
`PPSA99177.ffpkg` and `PPSA99177.ffpkg.sha256`: native TV app, including the same ELF.
`orbit-store-0.9.1-source-bundle.zip`: complete application source, corresponding dependency sources, licence notices and rebuild instructions for both programs.
Run `shasum -a 256 -c <filename>.sha256` beside each binary to verify it. Source-bundle contents have their own `SOURCE-SHA256SUMS`.
